contextual_families.reference: The Legend of Zelda Tears of the Kingdom
contextual_families.context: Dark adventure menus, item quick picking and map instruments

observations.text: Dark broad menu rows keep a clear text center with quiet end ornament and a warm selected rim; near-square material cells use a turquoise ring. Map callouts use blue/cyan planes.
Pale solid glyphs, separated menu groups and a distinct footer support the selected control. Different screen families use different accents and materials.

proposals.text: Use an original restrained edge vocabulary, clear label field and separate menu/picker/map families; choose accents by surface role.

limits: Static stills establish pictured selection, not hover, pressed, animation, controller behavior or hitboxes.
Source-raster envelopes are not universal control dimensions.

contextual_families.context: Friendly crafting confirmation and app-grid navigation

observations.text: Cream rounded panels, a turquoise striped craft capsule, pale rims and broad filled pictograms form a soft family. Dotted guides align material names with quantities.
NookPhone has a rounded 3 by 2 app grid with optically similar icon mass. App colors distinguish families; the supplemental shipping frame has a different emphasized color role.

proposals.text: Draw new rounded surfaces and glyphs; keep material quantities legible and the confirmed action distinct. Preserve app-grid navigation versus crafting execution.

limits: An illustrated cursor in a still is not hover evidence.
No selected NookPhone app or universal turquoise state is established.

observations.text: Square, shallow rows sit on dark translucent planes; pale selected rows invert text luminance. A narrow mint top mark distinguishes the selected tab.
Small left-aligned labels, right-aligned values, hairline separators and aligned slider ends carry hierarchy without independent rounded cards.

proposals.text: Use a new sharp grid and local luminance contrast for a dense settings task. Increase text and hit areas for the actual device instead of reproducing tiny raster text.

limits: One historical PC screen is not current Enhanced-client or general GTA HUD evidence.
Exact typeface, live behavior and source engine units are unknown.

contextual_families.context: Phone tabletop combat and explicit turn commitment

observations.text: A convex yellow End Turn plaque occupies a nested gray socket. Parchment, sculpted perimeter bands and separate cost/attack/health badges produce tabletop depth.
Large outlined numerals and arched or oval illustration windows differ from the partly clipped hand fan. Yellow turn commitment, blue cost and red health have distinct local roles.

proposals.text: Author new layered card frames and separated badges; reserve the heavier socket for turn commitment. Keep selection/inspection separate from explicit submission.

limits: The fan proves overlap, not usable overlapping text/targets or drag cancellation.
No collection/deck editor/store/expanded-card, touch reach, animation or current-client test established.

observations.text: Unequal lower-right action silhouettes surround a dominant sword. Smoky translucent circular/faceted grounds and broad white glyphs leave most of the scene center open.
Map and global functions occupy peripheral clusters. Health/latency and map direction have separate color roles; world blue is not an inventory palette specification.

proposals.text: Draw a coherent new glyph family with one dominant action and quieter companions. Test contrast across the scene; design inventory comparison as its own readable task surface.

limits: No movement joystick, cooldown, party-selector behavior or mobile equipment screen established.
Artwork extents are not CSS targets, 44pt/48dp, native resolution or ergonomic findings.

contextual_families.context: Learning choice, submitted-answer review and stable next action

observations.text: Rounded answer faces have thin borders and a short flat lower rim. Selected pale blue differs from explicit green success and red error feedback.

Submitted answers remain visible while explanatory feedback grows above a stable primary-action region. Tablet artwork centers the grid with wider margins; path, answer and character shapes have different jobs.

proposals.text: Use original lower-rim controls where tactility helps learning. Keep selection separate from judgment; preserve ink and a stable next action in pen-first layouts.
Keep drawing grids and writing canvas flat. Place an optional guide away from the response area and reward actual practice without importing mandatory streak pressure.

limits: No account opened or exercise submitted; keyboard, screen-reader order, haptics, recognition, palm rejection and recovery remain unverified.
Landscape tablet behavior, runtime fonts and current brand color specifications are not established.
